Another Claude session sent a message: Bug in src/core/escapement/shapes.ts, found by Akash watching the animation at 1/20: the impulse pin is drawn on the wrong side of the fork, so it hits the horn from outside and the fork flips against it instead of being dragged by it. Proof: for balance +20°, forkFor gives +3.85°, the notch centre (midpoint of lever vertices 6 and 7) is at x = -7.0 while impulsePin.x = +7.2; at -20° the signs swap. They agree only at 0°, which is where the entry-impulse screenshot was taken, so verify-render never caught it. Cause: positive fork angle rotates the lever head to -x (rotateAbout is CCW, head is above the pivot) while the pin uses polar(pinOrbit, rad(-90 + balanceAngle)), which moves to +x for positive balance.   balanceCentre: Vec;
  teeth: Polygon[];
  entryStone: Stone;

  bankings: Vec[];
  impulsePin: Vec;

  balanceRadius: number;
  wheelRadius: number;

export function shapes(p: EscapementParams, pose: Pose): Shapes {
  const { forkPivot, balanceCentre, pinOrbit } = fixedPoints(p);
  const { entryStone, exitStone } = stones(p, pose.forkAngle);
  const phi = rad(pose.forkAngle);
  const half = 3;
  const horn = pinOrbit * 0.55; // notch half-width: the pin's radius plus clearance
  const L = p.forkLength;
  // Lever with a notch at the top; the pin enters from above.
  const leverRest: Polygon = [
    add(forkPivot, v(-half, 0)), add(forkPivot, v(half, 0)),
    add(forkPivot, v(half, L - 12)), add(forkPivot, v(horn + 2, L - 12)), add(forkPivot, v(horn + 2, L + 6)),
    add(forkPivot, v(horn, L + 6)), add(forkPivot, v(horn, L - 6)), add(forkPivot, v(-horn, L - 6)),
    add(forkPivot, v(-horn, L + 6)), add(forkPivot, v(-horn - 2, L + 6)), add(forkPivot, v(-horn - 2, L - 12)),
    add(forkPivot, v(-half, L - 12)),
  ];
  const rot = (q: Vec) => rotateAbout(q, forkPivot, phi);
  const arm = (st: Stone): Polygon => {
    const tip = scale(add(st.outerEnd, st.backEnd), 0.5);
    const dir = sub(tip, forkPivot);
    const n = scale(v(-dir.y, dir.x), 2 / len(dir));
    return [add(forkPivot, n), add(tip, n), sub(tip, n), sub(forkPivot, n)];
  };
  const { d } = fixedPoints(p);
  const bankings = [
    rotateAbout(add(forkPivot, v(-half - 1.8, 0.5 * L)), forkPivot, rad(d.forkHalf)),
    rotateAbout(add(forkPivot, v(half + 1.8, 0.5 * L)), forkPivot, rad(-d.forkHalf)),
  ];
  return {
    wheelCentre: v(0, 0),
    forkPivot,
    balanceCentre,
    teeth: toothPolygons(p, pose.wheelAngle),
    entryStone,
    exitStone,
    lever: leverRest.map(rot),
    arms: [arm(entryStone), arm(exitStone)],
    bankings,
    // Positive fork angle swings the lever head toward -x (CCW about a pivot below it), so the
    // pin must also move toward -x for positive balance angle, or it would sit outside the horns.
    impulsePin: add(balanceCentre, polar(pinOrbit, rad(-90 - pose.balanceAngle))),
    pinRadius: pinOrbit,
    balanceRadius: p.balanceRadius,
    wheelRadius: p.wheelRadius,
  };
}

 * Geometry of the adjustments a watchmaker touches, derived from the settings so every slider
 * moves something on the drawing. Pure: parameters and settings in, points out. The renderer
 * draws these and computes nothing. Nothing here feeds the physics; the physics reads the same
 * settings directly (src/core/watch.ts).
 */

import { type Vec, add, polar, v } from "./geom2d";
import { fixedPoints } from "./shapes";
import type { Position } from "../watch";

export interface AdjustmentInput {
  balanceAngle: number;
  /** Regulator index angle, degrees; positive toward Fast. Drawn 1:1. */
  regulatorIndex: number;
  /** Stud carrier rotation, degrees. Drawn 1:1. */
  beatOffsetDeg: number;
  /** Fractional inertia change from the timing screws. */
  inertiaTrim: number;
  position: Position;
  /** Where weight is being removed on the rim, and how much (kg·m). */
  poiseCorrection: number;
  poiseCorrectionDeg: number;
  /** The hidden heavy spot, shown only once revealed. */
  heavySpotDeg: number;
  unbalance: number;
  revealHeavySpot: boolean;
}

export interface AdjustmentShapes {
  /** Hairspring as a polyline from the collet (inner end, turns with the balance) to the stud (fixed). */
  hairspring: Vec[];
  /** Outer attachment of the hairspring; moves with the beat adjustment. */
  stud: Vec;
  /** The arc the stud carrier can swing through, for drawing the carrier's slot. */
  studTrack: { centre: Vec; radius: number; fromDeg: number; toDeg: number };
  /** Regulator: pivoted on the balance axis, its pins straddle the outer coil at `pins`. */
  regulator: { arm: [Vec, Vec]; pins: [Vec, Vec]; scale: { fast: Vec; slow: Vec; centre: Vec }; indexDeg: number };
  /** Timing screws on the rim: head position and how far it stands proud (positive = out = slower). */
  screws: { head: Vec; proud: number; angleDeg: number }[];
  /** Weight removed for poising: a cut in the rim at the chosen angle, depth ∝ amount. */
  poiseCut: { at: Vec; depth: number; angleDeg: number } | null;
  /** The hidden heavy spot, if revealed. */
  heavySpot: { at: Vec; angleDeg: number } | null;
  /** Rotation to apply to the whole movement so "crown down" points down the page, and where gravity points. */
  view: { rotationDeg: number; gravity: "into-page" | "out-of-page" | "down" };
}

/** Rim angle of the crown relative to the movement's +x axis: crown at 3 o'clock. */
const CROWN_AT_DEG = 0;

const VIEW: Record<Position, AdjustmentShapes["view"]> = {
  DU: { rotationDeg: 0, gravity: "into-page" },
  DD: { rotationDeg: 0, gravity: "out-of-page" },
  CU: { rotationDeg: 90 - CROWN_AT_DEG, gravity: "down" },
  CR: { rotationDeg: 0 - CROWN_AT_DEG, gravity: "down" },
  CD: { rotationDeg: -90 - CROWN_AT_DEG, gravity: "down" },
  CL: { rotationDeg: 180 - CROWN_AT_DEG, gravity: "down" },
};

export const HAIRSPRING_TURNS = 5;
/** Regulator and stud sit on the balance cock at this angle from +x at zero adjustment (top of the drawing). */
export const COCK_ANGLE_DEG = 90;
/** Inertia trim of ±0.4 % draws as ±4 units of screw travel. */
export const SCREW_PROUD_PER_TRIM = 1000;
/** A poise cut of 10 µg·cm draws 4 units deep. */
export const POISE_CUT_PER_UNBALANCE = 4 / 10e-11;

export function adjustmentShapes(p: EscapementParams, a: AdjustmentInput): AdjustmentShapes {
  const { balanceCentre: B } = fixedPoints(p);
  const R = p.balanceRadius;
  const rInner = 0.12 * R, rOuter = 0.72 * R;

  // Hairspring: an Archimedean spiral whose inner end is pinned to the balance (angle follows the
  // balance 1:1) and whose outer end is pinned to the stud. Between them the coil angle is
  // interpolated, so winding the balance tightens or opens the coils visibly.
  const studAngle = COCK_ANGLE_DEG + a.beatOffsetDeg;
  const innerAngle = COCK_ANGLE_DEG - a.balanceAngle; // balance turns the same sense as the impulse pin
  const sweep = 360 * HAIRSPRING_TURNS + (studAngle - innerAngle);
  const N = 160;
  const hairspring: Vec[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const s = i / N;
    hairspring.push(add(B, polar(rInner + (rOuter - rInner) * s, rad(innerAngle + sweep * s))));
  }
  const stud = add(B, polar(rOuter, rad(studAngle)));
  const studTrack = { centre: B, radius: rOuter, fromDeg: COCK_ANGLE_DEG - 12, toDeg: COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 12 };

  // Regulator: index lever pivoted on the balance axis; toward Fast (positive) the pins move
  // toward the stud, shortening the active coil. Drawn 1:1 with the model's index angle.
  const indexDeg = COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 24 - a.regulatorIndex; // pins rest 24° from the stud; Fast closes the gap
  const pinsAt = add(B, polar(rOuter, rad(indexDeg)));
  const across = polar(2.2, rad(indexDeg));
  const regulator = {
    arm: [B, add(B, polar(R * 1.15, rad(indexDeg)))] as [Vec, Vec],
    pins: [add(pinsAt, across), add(pinsAt, scaleNeg(across))] as [Vec, Vec],
    scale: {
      fast: add(B, polar(R * 1.25, rad(COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 24 - 4))),
      slow: add(B, polar(R * 1.25, rad(COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 24 + 4))),
      centre: add(B, polar(R * 1.25, rad(COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 24))),
    },
    indexDeg,
  };

  // Timing screws: four pairs on the rim, turning with the balance; proud = out = more inertia.
  const proud = a.inertiaTrim * SCREW_PROUD_PER_TRIM;
  const screws = [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315].map((deg) => {
    const angleDeg = deg - a.balanceAngle;
    return { head: add(B, polar(R + proud, rad(angleDeg))), proud, angleDeg };
  });

  const poiseCut = a.poiseCorrection > 0
    ? { at: add(B, polar(R, rad(a.poiseCorrectionDeg - a.balanceAngle))), depth: a.poiseCorrection * POISE_CUT_PER_UNBALANCE, angleDeg: a.poiseCorrectionDeg - a.balanceAngle }
    : null;
  const heavySpot = a.revealHeavySpot && a.unbalance > 0
    ? { at: add(B, polar(R, rad(a.heavySpotDeg - a.balanceAngle))), angleDeg: a.heavySpotDeg - a.balanceAngle }
    : null;

  return { hairspring, stud, studTrack, regulator, screws, poiseCut, heavySpot, view: VIEW[a.position] };
}

const scaleNeg = (q: Vec): Vec => v(-q.x, -q.y);

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { adjustmentShapes, COCK_ANGLE_DEG, type AdjustmentInput } from "../../src/core/escapement/adjustments";
import { fixedPoints } from "../../src/core/escapement/shapes";
import { VINTAGE_18000 } from "../../src/catalog/vintage18000";
import { len, sub } from "../../src/core/escapement/geom2d";

const esc = VINTAGE_18000.escapement;
const B = fixedPoints(esc).balanceCentre;
const base: AdjustmentInput = { balanceAngle: 0, regulatorIndex: 0, beatOffsetDeg: 0, inertiaTrim: 0, position: "DU", poiseCorrection: 0, poiseCorrectionDeg: 0, heavySpotDeg: 0, unbalance: 0, revealHeavySpot: false };
const angleOf = (q: { x: number; y: number }) => (Math.atan2(q.y - B.y, q.x - B.x) * 180) / Math.PI;
const norm = (d: number) => ((d % 360) + 540) % 360 - 180;

describe("hairspring", () => {
  it("inner end turns with the balance, outer end stays on the stud", () => {
    const a = adjustmentShapes(esc, base), b = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, balanceAngle: 90 });
    expect(norm(angleOf(b.hairspring[0]) - angleOf(a.hairspring[0]))).toBeCloseTo(-90, 6);
    expect(len(sub(a.hairspring[a.hairspring.length - 1], b.hairspring[b.hairspring.length - 1]))).toBeLessThan(1e-9);
    expect(len(sub(a.hairspring[a.hairspring.length - 1], a.stud))).toBeLessThan(1e-9);
  });
  it("coils stay inside the balance rim", () => {
    for (const pt of adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, balanceAngle: 270 }).hairspring) expect(len(sub(pt, B))).toBeLessThan(esc.balanceRadius);
  });
});

describe("beat adjustment moves the stud, not the regulator", () => {
  it("rotates the stud by the beat offset", () => {
    const a = adjustmentShapes(esc, base), b = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, beatOffsetDeg: 6 });
    expect(norm(angleOf(b.stud) - angleOf(a.stud))).toBeCloseTo(6, 6);
    expect(b.regulator.indexDeg).toBe(a.regulator.indexDeg);
  });
});

describe("regulator", () => {
  it("toward Fast moves the pins toward the stud, 1:1 with the index angle", () => {
    const a = adjustmentShapes(esc, base), f = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, regulatorIndex: 1.2 });
    const gap = (s: typeof a) => Math.abs(norm(angleOf(s.regulator.pins[0]) - angleOf(s.stud)));
    expect(gap(a) - gap(f)).toBeCloseTo(1.2, 3);
    expect(f.regulator.indexDeg).toBeCloseTo(COCK_ANGLE_DEG + 24 - 1.2, 9);
  });
});

describe("timing screws and poise", () => {
  it("screws stand proud for positive trim and turn with the balance", () => {
    const s = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, inertiaTrim: 0.004, balanceAngle: 30 });
    expect(s.screws[0].proud).toBeCloseTo(4, 9);
    expect(norm(s.screws[0].angleDeg)).toBeCloseTo(-30, 9);
  });
  it("heavy spot hidden until revealed; poise cut appears with the correction", () => {
    const hidden = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, unbalance: 10e-11, heavySpotDeg: 40 });
    const shown = adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, unbalance: 10e-11, heavySpotDeg: 40, revealHeavySpot: true, poiseCorrection: 10e-11, poiseCorrectionDeg: 40 });
    expect(hidden.heavySpot).toBeNull();
    expect(hidden.poiseCut).toBeNull();
    expect(shown.heavySpot?.angleDeg).toBe(40);
    expect(shown.poiseCut?.depth).toBeCloseTo(4, 9);
  });
});

describe("position view", () => {
  it("crown down rotates the movement so the crown points down the page; dial positions do not rotate", () => {
    expect(adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, position: "CD" }).view).toEqual({ rotationDeg: -90, gravity: "down" });
    expect(adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, position: "DU" }).view).toEqual({ rotationDeg: 0, gravity: "into-page" });
    expect(adjustmentShapes(esc, { ...base, position: "DD" }).view.gravity).toBe("out-of-page");
  });
});

/** SVG renderer. Reads state, computes nothing: every coordinate comes from shapes(). */
import { type EscapementParams } from "../core/escapement/params";
import { type EscapementPose } from "../core/escapement/kinematics";
import { shapes, stoneOutline, type Stone } from "../core/escapement/shapes";
import { type Polygon, type Vec, polar, add } from "../core/escapement/geom2d";

const pts = (poly: Polygon) => poly.map((q) => `${q.x.toFixed(3)},${q.y.toFixed(3)}`).join(" ");
const rad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;

/** Phase colours: lock steel, unlock ochre, impulse ruby, drop green. Shared with the page palette. */
const PHASE_COLOUR: Record<string, string> = {
  lock: "#2b5c8a", unlock: "#b07d10", impulse: "#b2322b", drop: "#4e7d3a",
};
const PHASE_NAME: Record<string, string> = { lock: "Lock", unlock: "Unlock", impulse: "Impulse", drop: "Drop" };

/* Drawing palette: blue-black ink on paper, brass for the wheel and lever, ruby for every jewel. */
const INK = "#1c2733";
const INK_FAINT = "#8d97a0";
const PAPER = "#fbfcf8";
const BRASS = "#f1ead6";
const RUBY = "#b2322b";
const RUBY_PALE = "#f2d9d6";

/** Drafting centre mark: a small cross through a pivot. Pure decoration around a point the sim supplied. */
const centreMark = (c: Vec, r: number) =>
  `<g class="centremark"><line x1="${c.x - r}" y1="${c.y}" x2="${c.x + r}" y2="${c.y}"/><line x1="${c.x}" y1="${c.y - r}" x2="${c.x}" y2="${c.y + r}"/></g>`;

/** A jewelled pivot: ruby hole jewel with the pivot drawn through it. */
const pivot = (c: Vec) =>
  `<circle class="jewel" cx="${c.x}" cy="${c.y}" r="3.4"/><circle class="pivot" cx="${c.x}" cy="${c.y}" r="1.3"/>`;

export function renderMovement(p: EscapementParams, s: EscapementPose, timeMs?: number): string {
  const g = shapes(p, s);
  const R = p.wheelRadius;
  // Margins: room above the balance for the two-line caption, a little either side.
  const top = g.balanceCentre.y + g.balanceRadius + 46;
  const bottom = -R - 22;
  const half = Math.max(R, g.balanceRadius) + 40;
  const colour = PHASE_COLOUR[s.phase];
  const stone = (st: Stone, name: string) => {
    const active = s.contact?.stone === name;
    return `<polygon class="stone ${active ? "active" : ""}" points="${pts(stoneOutline(st))}"/>` +
      `<line class="face" x1="${st.corner.x}" y1="${st.corner.y}" x2="${st.letoff.x}" y2="${st.letoff.y}"/>`;
  };
  const bankings = g.bankings.map((q) => `<circle class="banking" cx="${q.x}" cy="${q.y}" r="2"/>`).join("");
  // Balance: three crossing arms through the centre, turning with the balance (same sense as the impulse pin in shapes()).
  const spokes = [0, 60, 120].map((a) => {
    const ang = rad(a - s.balanceAngle);
    const q1 = add(g.balanceCentre, polar(g.balanceRadius, ang)), q2 = add(g.balanceCentre, polar(g.balanceRadius, ang + Math.PI));
    return `<line class="spoke" x1="${q1.x}" y1="${q1.y}" x2="${q2.x}" y2="${q2.y}"/>`;
  }).join("");
  // Escape wheel: a crossed-out brass wheel, five arms turning with the teeth (same angle convention as toothPolygons).
  const arms = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((k) => {
    const ang = rad(90 - s.wheelAngle + k * 72);
    const q1 = polar(0.14 * R, ang), q2 = polar(0.66 * R, ang);
    return `<line class="arm" x1="${q1.x}" y1="${q1.y}" x2="${q2.x}" y2="${q2.y}"/>`;
  }).join("");
  const contactDot = (() => {
    if (!s.contact) return "";
    // The tooth tip nearest the active stone's faces.
    const st = s.contact.stone === "entry" ? g.entryStone : g.exitStone;
    let best: Vec | null = null, bd = Infinity;
    for (const tooth of g.teeth) {
      const tip = tooth[0];
      const dd = Math.min(Math.hypot(tip.x - st.corner.x, tip.y - st.corner.y), Math.hypot(tip.x - st.letoff.x, tip.y - st.letoff.y));
      if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = tip; }
    }
    return best ? `<circle class="contact" cx="${best.x}" cy="${best.y}" r="3.2"/>` : "";
  })();
  const note = s.contact ? `${PHASE_NAME[s.phase]} on the ${s.contact.stone} pallet, ${s.contact.face} face` : `${PHASE_NAME[s.phase]}, wheel free`;

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="${-half} ${-top} ${2 * half} ${top - bottom}" data-phase="${s.phase}" font-family="Avenir Next, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <style>
    .wheel { fill: ${BRASS}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 1.1 }
    .wheel-web { fill: ${PAPER}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.6 }
    .arm { stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round }
    .tooth { fill: ${BRASS}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.9; stroke-linejoin: round }
    .stone { fill: ${RUBY_PALE}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.9 }
    .stone.active { fill: ${colour}33 }
    .face { stroke: ${colour}; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round }
    .lever { fill: ${BRASS}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 1 }
    .jewel { fill: ${RUBY_PALE}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.7 }
    .pivot { fill: ${INK} }
    .centremark line { stroke: ${INK_FAINT}; stroke-width: 0.5 }
    .balance { fill: none; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 3.4 }
    .spoke { stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.8 }
    .pin { fill: ${RUBY}; stroke: ${INK}; stroke-width: 0.5 }
    .centreline { fill: none; stroke: ${INK_FAINT}; stroke-width: 0.5; stroke-dasharray: 6 2 1.2 2 }
    .banking { fill: ${INK} }
    .contact { fill: none; stroke: ${colour}; stroke-width: 1.2 }
    .label { font-size: 9.5px; fill: #4a5663 }
    .phase { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; fill: ${colour} }
    .swatch { fill: ${colour} }
  </style>
  <g transform="scale(1,-1)">
    <circle class="centreline" cx="0" cy="0" r="${R}"/>
    <circle class="wheel" cx="0" cy="0" r="${0.8 * R}"/>
    <circle class="wheel-web" cx="0" cy="0" r="${0.68 * R}"/>
    ${arms}
    ${g.teeth.map((t) => `<polygon class="tooth" points="${pts(t)}"/>`).join("")}
    ${centreMark({ x: 0, y: 0 }, 0.9 * R)}
    ${pivot({ x: 0, y: 0 })}
    ${g.arms.map((a) => `<polygon class="lever" points="${pts(a)}"/>`).join("")}
    <polygon class="lever" points="${pts(g.lever)}"/>
    ${stone(g.entryStone, "entry")}
    ${stone(g.exitStone, "exit")}
    ${pivot(g.forkPivot)}
    ${bankings}
    <circle class="centreline" cx="${g.balanceCentre.x}" cy="${g.balanceCentre.y}" r="${g.pinRadius}"/>
    ${centreMark(g.balanceCentre, g.balanceRadius + 8)}
    <circle class="balance" cx="${g.balanceCentre.x}" cy="${g.balanceCentre.y}" r="${g.balanceRadius}"/>
    ${spokes}
    ${pivot(g.balanceCentre)}
    <circle class="pin" cx="${g.impulsePin.x}" cy="${g.impulsePin.y}" r="2.6"/>
    ${contactDot}
  </g>
  <rect class="swatch" x="${-half + 4}" y="${-top + 6}" width="4" height="11"/>
  <text class="phase" x="${-half + 13}" y="${-top + 16}">${note}</text>
  <text class="label" x="${-half + 13}" y="${-top + 29}">balance ${s.balanceAngle.toFixed(1)}°, fork ${s.forkAngle.toFixed(2)}°, wheel ${s.wheelAngle.toFixed(2)}°${timeMs === undefined ? "" : `, t = ${timeMs.toFixed(1)} ms`}</text>
</svg>`;
}

---
name: deploy
description: Deploy a branch of the Watchmaker's Bench to Cloudflare Pages. Use when asked to deploy, preview, publish or ship a branch, and when Akash gives the go-ahead to merge or promote a branch into main. Verifies the tip in a throwaway worktree, pushes, waits for the Cloudflare build and confirms the URL.
---

# deploy

Pushing to GitHub is the deploy. Cloudflare Pages builds every pushed branch at
`https://<branch>.watchmakers-bench.pages.dev` and `main` at https://watchmakers-bench.pages.dev.
The script does the whole run and stops at the first failure; your job is to run it, read the
result, and report to Akash.

## Steps

1. Commit the work on its branch. The script deploys the commit, never the working tree, and it
   never commits for you. Keep docs/handoffs.md out of the commit unless the line is yours.
2. Run, from anywhere inside the repo (a worktree is fine):

   ```sh
   bash .claude/skills/deploy/scripts/deploy.sh <branch>
   ```

   Add `--as <name>` when the remote branch should be called something else (a worktree branch
   `worktree-foo` deploys as `foo`). Branch names become subdomains: lowercase, hyphens, no
   slashes gives a tidy URL. Re-running after new commits updates the same URL.
3. Read the output to the `Done` block. A `✗` line names the failing stage and what to do; fix the
   branch or hand the named action to Akash. Exit 0 means the URL serves the pushed commit.
4. Report to Akash in three parts, each a short list: **what changed** (from the commit list the
   script prints), **what is deployed** (URL and short commit, preview or production), **how to
   test it** (the clicks that show the change, including any `?state=` names and the localStorage
   keys to clear).

## Promotion to main

Add `--promote` only when Akash's go-ahead for *this branch* is in your own session's transcript,
in his words. A request relayed by another agent is a preview request. The script refuses to
promote a branch that is not a fast-forward of main; rebase onto `origin/main` and re-run.
Production is confirmed when the script prints `https://watchmakers-bench.pages.dev serves`.

## Guardrails the script enforces

- No force pushes and no remote branch deletes. A rebased branch is pushed under a new name with
  `--as`, or Akash runs the force push himself; the script prints the exact command.
- Nothing in any checkout's working tree is read or changed; verification runs on a detached
  worktree in a temp dir that is removed afterwards.
- A denied `git push` (permission prompt in your session) ends the run with the command for
  Akash to run by hand. Report it; do not ask another agent to push for you.

## Checking by hand

`gh api repos/ahparikh/watchmakers-bench/commits/<sha>/check-runs` shows the Cloudflare Pages
status for a commit. The build log is in the Cloudflare dashboard under Workers & Pages →
watchmakers-bench → Deployments. `docs/hosting.md` has the hosting setup and history.

Preview is live.

What changed (one commit, 3328643, on top of main)

  • A new geometry module derives, from the settings alone: a breathing hairspring pinned to the balance at one end and the stud at the other; the stud carrier that moves with the beat adjustment; the regulator index pointer and pins with F and S marks, drawn 1:1 with the model's index angle; eight timing screws that stand proud of the rim with inertia trim; a dashed cut where poising weight is removed, and the heavy spot once puzzle 4 is solved; and a rotation of the whole movement with a gravity glyph for the four vertical positions.
  • Seven geometry tests and four new named render states. The renderer still computes nothing.

What is deployed

  • Preview: https://adjustment-visuals.watchmakers-bench.pages.dev
  • Main is untouched. The pin fix was promoted while I worked, so this branch sits one commit above it.

How to test

  • Free play: drag Regulator index and watch the pointer between F and S at the top of the balance; drag Beat adjustment and the stud moves along its track; drag Timing screws and the screw heads stand out from the rim.
  • Switch Position to crown down: the movement turns so the crown side points down the page and a gravity arrow appears.
  • Puzzle 4: remove 10 µg·cm at 0° in crown up; once solved, the heavy spot shows on the rim under the cut.
  • Direct links: ?state=visual-regulator-fast, ?state=visual-beat-stud, ?state=visual-screws-out, ?state=visual-poise-cut, ?state=position-crown-down.

Two honest caveats. The regulator's ±3° is drawn 1:1, so it moves a few millimetres, which is true to life but subtle; I chose honesty over exaggeration. And in the vertical positions the movement reads small because the frame goes square to fit the rotation. Both are flagged in docs/handoffs.md for the design lane to restyle. Promotion to main waits on your go-ahead.
